title: Casual UI/UX Artist
desc: iLogos Game Studios provides solutions for mobile game developers no matter how challenging the project or task is. We’ve been around since 2006 and in that time frame, we have successfully completed 400+ projects and have become a partner of choice for EA, Sony, Disney, Rovio, Ubisoft, and many other companies. We're looking for a talented Game UI/UX Artist to join iLogos Game Studios and create engaging, colorful, and intuitive interfaces for an exciting mobile F2P endless runner! We're especially interested in artists who combine strong game UI/UX design skills, creative visual thinking, and hands-on AI-assisted workflows to deliver polished, production-ready interfaces. About the Project We're developing a mobile F2P endless runner in Unity for iOS and Android, inspired by the fast-paced gameplay of Subway Surfers , but with a fresh visual identity. Our game features expressive anthropomorphic animal characters traveling around the world through vibrant, stylized urban environments. The visual direction combines high-quality cartoon 3D, playful character design, bold colors, and street culture aesthetics . Players will explore three unique locations, while unlocking characters, customizing hoverboards, collecting rewards, and completing daily challenges. Our goal is to create a visually distinctive, engaging mobile experience with intuitive navigation and appealing F2P progression systems. What we’re looking for: 3+ years of professional experience in game UI/UX design for mobile F2P games. Strong portfolio featuring stylized game interfaces , preferably from casual or midcore mobile projects. Experience creating visually appealing cartoon-style UI art , including icons, panels, buttons, and in-game interface elements. Proficiency in Figma and Adobe Photoshop . Practical experience designing F2P monetization interfaces , including stores, offers, bundles, currencies, and reward systems. Strong understanding of mobile UX principles, user flows, visual hierarchy, and responsive layouts. Experience preparing and handing off UI assets for Unity integration , including slicing, anchors, safe areas, and different screen resolutions. Strong hands-on experience with generative AI tools for UI art, icons, and visual asset creation. Ability to demonstrate independently developed or customized AI-assisted workflows , including style consistency, paint-over, manual refinement, and production-ready results. Ability to collaborate efficiently with artists, designers, and developers in a production environment. Nice to have: Experience creating UI animations, transitions, and interactive effects . Previous experience with endless runners or successful casual mobile games . Hands-on experience implementing UI directly in Unity. Experience designing character customization or cosmetic selection interfaces. Familiarity with mobile F2P engagement and retention mechanics. What the role is about: Design and create engaging game UI/UX for a mobile F2P endless runner, including: Main menus and navigation: home screen, settings, and game modes. Character customization: character and hoverboard selection screens. Monetization UI: in-game store, special offers, bundles, chests, and rewards. Player engagement systems: daily missions, leaderboards, progression, and reward screens. Gameplay UI: in-run HUD, power-up indicators, and results screens. Create high-quality stylized cartoon UI art , including icons, buttons, panels, and decorative elements. Develop intuitive UX flows, wireframes, and responsive layouts for different mobile screen sizes and aspect ratios. Maintain visual consistency with the game's vibrant, street-culture-inspired art direction. Ensure excellent readability, usability, and visual hierarchy across gameplay and menu interfaces. Prepare production-ready UI assets, including slicing, exports, and organized handoff for Unity integration . Collaborate closely with the Art Lead, Game Designers, and Developers to refine UI functionality and visual quality. Apply AI-assisted workflows to accelerate UI art creation, icon production, visual exploration, and asset variations. Contribute to the development and improvement of the studio's AI art production pipelines . Working conditions: Our people are what we value the most at iLogos. We treat everyone with respect no matter where you are from or what you believe in. If you share our values which are Mastery, Maturity, Trust & Care, and Positive Mindset – we are a perfect match for each other! Join #ilogos_team and we guarantee you an opportunity for growth, support, and an atmosphere of trust and care that feels more like a family. And as well: Work remotely from anywhere in the world; Flexible working hours. Workload: Full-time with transitioning to part-time. Opportunity to shape the UI/UX of a colorful, character-driven mobile game. Collaborative production environment with a strong focus on AI-enhanced game art workflows . Opportunity to contribute to the development of the studio's AI-assisted art production processes. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Digital Product Designer
desc: Digital Product Designer Are you a talented designer with a passion for product management? Do you thrive in fast-paced, ever-changing environments where your ideas can shape real impact? If so, we want you on our team! Join Codekeeper and bring your creativity, vision, and drive to a role where every day presents new challenges and opportunities to make a difference. Applications are open for the next two months ! About the Role As a designer, your primary focus will be transforming customer needs into user journeys and creating visually appealing and intuitive interfaces. Your design skills will play a pivotal role in turning ideas into tangible products that our development team will bring to life. What You’ll Be Doing Translate customer needs into user journeys and design beautiful and intuitive interfaces. Collaborate with the Product Manager and/or Creative Director to conduct research, design, and prototype new user experiences. Develop user cases, scenarios, wireframes, prototypes, and mockups for screens and flows. Create visual assets and document design guidelines for implementation. Present and effectively communicate designs and deliverables to peers and executives. Why Codekeeper ? Codekeeper was founded by tech industry professionals to revolutionize software escrow for the cloud era. We offer state-of-the-art software escrow solutions that mitigate third-party risks in business operations. As a remote-first company with a central office in The Hague, we prioritize a healthy, resilient organization to support the development of our robust app. What You Can Expect Passionate and fun-loving colleagues Startup mindset with ample opportunities for growth Regular team activities and gatherings Comprehensive onboarding process with a dedicated ramp-up period A supportive team that values open communication and direct feedback A chance to excel in your career and make a difference About You Proficient copywriting skills in English. Strong understanding of color theory and typography. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. Dedication, enthusiasm, and a sense of humor. Access to a Mac with Figma (or preference for this design tool). Additional Requirements Analysis of user journeys. Working with design systems and symbol libraries. Additional Info Remote ( Join us to shape the future of software escrow! How to Apply To apply, use the Apply button on this listing. In your application, tell us how you would like to fill this position. There are no right answers or expectations. Show us your role in our company’s future and our role in yours, address some of the work we do, and introduce yourself as a colleague. Please note: Applications and follow-ups sent through any other channel, such as our customer website chat, support email or direct messages to team members, won’t be considered. Need an accessibility adjustment to apply? Visit Our Careers Page for how to reach us. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Product Designer
desc: Headquarters: United States - Remote Tebra only initiates contact with candidates via email from an official Tebra email address (@ tebra.com , @ patientpop.com , or @ kareo.com ) or through our applicant tracking system, Greenhouse. We will only ask you to provide sensitive personal information through our official application portal — not via social media or text message. We do not conduct interviews via instant messaging. About the Role We are looking for a customer-focused individual to help shape the future of our Tebra platform. This role is an exciting and challenging opportunity to be a partner in an embedded team of cross-functional counterparts. You will be joining a close-knit, collaborative product design culture with a focus on raising the bar of the day-to-day product experience for our healthcare providers and their patients. Your Area of Focus You contribute to the vision and design strategy that connects customer and business value. You have strong creative and conceptual design skills and the ability to evolve ideas that drive innovation. You have an effortless working knowledge of design fundamentals, principles, and core skills.  You build and utilize your product knowledge to navigate ambiguity, identify opportunities and define customer problem statements.  You need minimal direction on design methods and approaches to validate solutions.  You can facilitate cross-functional, collaborative ideation sessions using a variety of methods. You make proficient use of design system guidelines and contribute to components and patterns that include optimization and refinements to structural elements and patterns. You are a strong collaborator and communicator who creates understanding, drives alignment, and can work independently.   You are an effective presenter with the ability to anticipate questions and concerns, articulate a data supported point of view, synthesize and process feedback, and determine next steps. You have a working knowledge of business logic and dependencies between design, front-end development, and back-end technologies and the ability to successfully navigate the capabilities and constraints of existing technical systems. You work closely and in partnership with your product and engineering counterparts and outside of your core team inclusive of other designers, research, marketing, sales, and customer service. You can lead customer research sessions with some support and: interview customers effectively; guide the process to glean effective insights; and uncover and socialize areas of opportunity.  You possess a working understanding of various research methods, including rapid prototyping, card sorting, affinity mapping.  You are comfortable evaluating and leveraging AI tools to augment processes that result in efficiency and quality improvement. You seek out and incorporate both quantitative and qualitative data for use in reasoning and decision making. You seek out feedback and inputs from a variety of sources in order to move solutions forward, drive innovation, contribute to a connected and holistic overall experience for our customers and users, and invest in your relationships with peers and stakeholders. Your Professional Qualifications 3+ years of experience in a Product Design role (or comparable equivalent experience). Experience in B2B and/or B2C (SMB customer experience a plus; previous Healthcare a plus). Has a portfolio that demonstrates the following: Ability to deliver simplified, intuitive, and responsive user experiences for complex operations and flows (desktop web, mobile web, native app). Ability to use data insights to iterate on design solutions. Accomplished to expert level in several of the following skills: UX Design Visual User Interface Design Interaction Design Responsive Design Mobile + native mobile design Rapid Prototyping + iterative design Information Architecture Accessibility Qualitative + Quantitative data synthesis Experience working with a design system. Expert with Figma and FigJam. Proficiency in a variety of modern AI tools (such as Figma Make, Claude, Gemini, or Codex). Growth Mindset. #LI-SS1 #LI-Remote In compliance with California's pay transparency laws, the compensation range for this position will be provided and may include an hourly rate, annual salary, or On-Target Earnings (OTE), depending on the nature of the role. The specific compensation structure and detailed range will be discussed with qualified candidates during the initial talent screen. Remote Pay Range $121,500 — $143,000 USD   About Tebra Tebra is the only all-in-one EHR+ platform built exclusively for independent healthcare practices. Designed to replace the clunky, fragmented tools built for corporate systems, Tebra connects EHR software, billing, automation, telehealth solution, and marketing — so providers can spend less time on admin and more time with patients. More than 42,000 private practices trust Tebra to streamline operations, increase revenue, and reduce burnout — helping clinicians leave work on time and rediscover their purpose. Learn more at  www.tebra.com . Our Values Start with the Customer  We get to know our customers - and their patients - and look at the world through their lens. Keep It Simple Healthcare is too complex. We aim to simplify it for everyone. Stay Entrepreneurial  We reject the status quo and solve problems with creativity, perseverance, and a bias to action. Better Together We are diverse, humble, and collaborative. We put the team first and win together. Celebrate Success Life is short and joy is underrated. We take time to have fun and celebrate success. Perks & Benefits  United States: In addition to our healthcare benefits, we also offer amazing perks! Need work from home basics? We offer a discount through Dell! We also offer a number of resources to help you keep your mind and body healthy.
